name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully fetched the quickstart docs and created the Next.js scaffold (`npx create-next-app@latest my-copilot-app` completed with "Success! Created my-copilot-app at /home/daytona/my-copilot-app"). However, I was blocked at the `npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/react-ui @copilotkit/runtime` step because the sandbox's root filesystem (3 GB) was completely full, producing `ENOSPC: no space left on device` errors. I attempted to clear npm/yarn caches and remove large global packages, but the disk remained at 100% capacity, preventing any package installation. Consequently, I never reached creating the `.env` file, the API route, the CopilotKit provider wrapper, or starting the dev server.
